name: Solo Drama Competition
benefit: - First prize winner receives ₹2,000/-. - Second prize winner receives ₹1,500/-. - Original Drama category winner receives ₹500/-. - Best Director receives ₹500/-. - Best Writer receives ₹500/-. - Best Scene Composition receives ₹500/-. _*The benefits are disbursed as one-time cash prizes awarded after the competition results are declared._
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be willing to participate in a solo drama competition. - The applicant must perform a solo theatrical act as per the competition requirements.
